methods.unverifiedHint: An administrator added it and you haven't signed in with it yet.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp
whatsapp.onlyMethod: It's your only sign-in method: to unlink it, add an email first.

chat.help: With the chat linked to your account, notices and forms reach you on WhatsApp.

notices.label: Notices
notices.help: WhatsApp lets us send you notices for 24 hours after your last message. Write to us and they start again.

linkWhatsApp.title: Add number
linkWhatsApp.taken: This number is already linked to another account. If it's yours, ask an administrator to release it.

addEmail.title: Add email
addEmail.taken: This email is already in another account. If it's yours, ask an administrator to release it.

unlinkWhatsApp.title: Unlink your WhatsApp?
unlinkWhatsApp.description: You won't be able to sign in with {{phone}} or from the chat anymore. You can link it again whenever you want.
